name: Resource pack
summary: A resource pack for Minecraft: Java Edition: change texts, models and textures, with the right pack format for the chosen version.
description: A folder that goes straight into the resourcepacks folder. Nothing to build. It starts with two small text-only changes you can see at once (a renamed menu button and a stick that looks like a blaze rod) and notes on where your own pictures go.

options.label: Pack name
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only

options.label: Description
options.help: Shown under the pack's name in the resource pack list.

options.label: Minecraft version
options.help: Sets the pack format in pack.mcmeta. Resource packs and data packs count their formats separately.

options.label: Example text change
options.help: Renames the Singleplayer button on the title screen, so you can see the pack is active.

options.label: Example model change
options.help: Makes sticks look like blaze rods, using a texture the game already has.

next: In the game: Options, Resource Packs, move the pack to the Selected side, Done.
The title screen button and the stick show the pack is active.
Put your own pictures under assets\minecraft\textures (see the readme.txt there), then press F3+T in game to reload.
